CITY OF EXAMPLE REQUEST FOR QUOTATION
Responses must be submitted by September 18, 2026 at 2:00 PM ET through the procurement portal.
The contractor shall hold an active state electrical license at submission.
The contractor must maintain $2,000,000 general liability insurance.
Offerors shall provide three examples of comparable work completed in the past five years.
Technical approach will be evaluated for best value.
The estimated contract value is $180,000.
